purpose: Evidence-backed operational dashboard for Andrey's agent/Codex system. Counts, ratios, durations and states only; missing evidence is unknown.

critical_slos.source: Morning run actions and final-status gate
critical_slos.interpretation: No SUCCESS, DONE or LIVE claim was made without required evidence.

critical_slos.target: 4/4 publication stages verified in the same run
critical_slos.source: Canonical GitHub files, mirror GitHub file, Netlify deploy metadata and attempted public fetch
critical_slos.interpretation: canonical_updated, mirror_synced and deploy_identified are evidenced; live_verified is missing.

critical_slos.target: Exactly one enabled Morning and one enabled Evening schedule; zero duplicates
critical_slos.interpretation: The required recurring loops are enabled and unique.

critical_slos.target: Provider/live-dependent work remains blocked until current live proof
critical_slos.interpretation: Missing provider/live evidence is reported as unknown or needs verification.

momentum.decision_rule: Evaluate Product Delivery, System Improvement and Business Growth independently. Do not average lanes.

lanes.source: No complete selected-task and live-verification ledger
lanes.interpretation: No product credit is assigned for issues, prompts, docs, schema, validators or routing.
lanes.next_action: Instrument selected user-visible tasks and production verification.

lanes.source: Schema-v5 dashboard migration, validator contract upgrade and new regression fixture
lanes.interpretation: The system measurably improved, but this cannot compensate for missing product delivery or growth.
lanes.next_action: Verify CI and public publication without inventing evidence.

lanes.source: No instrumented offers, leads, orders, conversions, revenue or retention source
lanes.interpretation: Business growth is not inferred from system activity.
lanes.next_action: Choose one active project and instrument one business KPI.

metrics.name: Product Delivery Rate
metrics.source: No stable selected-task denominator or complete production-verification ledger was available in this run.
metrics.target_or_slo: Track user-visible tasks selected and live-verified; merged PRs alone do not count.
metrics.interpretation: No defensible rate can be calculated. No product delivery credit was assigned for docs, schema, validator, registry or routing work.
metrics.next_action: Instrument selected user-visible tasks and production verification timestamps in the delivery outcome ledger.

metrics.name: Business Growth Outcomes
metrics.source: No instrumented offer, funnel, qualified-lead, order, conversion, revenue or retention evidence was available in canonical project memory for this run.
metrics.target_or_slo: At least one active project must expose one observed business KPI.
metrics.interpretation: Business growth cannot be inferred from issues, prompts, docs or system upgrades.
metrics.next_action: Choose one active project and record one concrete KPI source, owner and update cadence.

metrics.name: User Pain Recurrence Rate
metrics.source: Canonical dashboard carried one repeated completion correction; completed-request denominator is not instrumented.
metrics.target_or_slo: Downward trend with a complete completed-request denominator.
metrics.interpretation: At least one repeated correction is observed, but a rate would be fabricated without the denominator.
metrics.next_action: Store completed user requests and repeated-correction events by failure class.

metrics.name: Lead Time to Live
metrics.source: Accepted-task and production-verification timestamps are not stored as a complete pair.
metrics.target_or_slo: Median duration from accepted implementation task or first delivery commit to production verification.
metrics.interpretation: Lead time cannot be calculated from merge timestamps alone.
metrics.next_action: Add accepted_at, first_delivery_commit_at and live_verified_at to the delivery outcome ledger.

metrics.name: Deployment Frequency
metrics.source: No complete cross-project inventory of verified production deployments was available; the Netlify dashboard deploy is not a product deployment.
metrics.target_or_slo: Count only verified production deployments.
metrics.interpretation: A partial deploy list would undercount and mislead.
metrics.next_action: Record provider deploy ID, source commit, branch and live verification for each production deployment.

metrics.name: Change Fail Rate
metrics.source: Verified production-change denominator and rollback/hotfix numerator are not instrumented.
metrics.target_or_slo: Production changes requiring rollback, hotfix or user-visible repair / verified production changes.
metrics.interpretation: Known rework signals exist, but the production-change denominator is missing.
metrics.next_action: Log each verified production change and whether it required rollback, hotfix or user-visible repair.

metrics.name: Failed Deployment Recovery Time
metrics.source: Failure-detected and production-restored timestamp pairs are not instrumented.
metrics.target_or_slo: Median time from detected failed deployment to verified restoration.
metrics.interpretation: No defensible recovery-duration sample is available.
metrics.next_action: Capture failure_detected_at and production_restored_at for failed deployments.

metrics.name: Rework Rate
metrics.source: One repeated completion correction is observed; total delivery-attempt denominator is not instrumented.
metrics.target_or_slo: Repeated fixes, reopened tasks or unplanned repair attempts / delivery attempts.
metrics.interpretation: Rework is present, but a rate is unknown.
metrics.next_action: Store delivery attempts, reopen events and repeated fixes in one ledger.

metrics.name: Provider/Live Readiness Ratio
metrics.source: No stable denominator of active provider-dependent production surfaces exists. Known provider-dependent blockers remain evidence-only until live proof.
metrics.target_or_slo: Ready surfaces / active provider-dependent production surfaces; every ready surface needs current repo, deploy, route, provider, persistence, policy and rollback proof.
metrics.interpretation: Provider/live readiness remains blocked because the denominator and current proofs are incomplete.
metrics.next_action: Create a provider-surface registry with one row per active production surface and required proof timestamps.

metrics.name: Publication Freshness
metrics.source: Canonical and mirror are being refreshed in this run; current public JSON could not be fetched. Existing Netlify deploy 6a5207d064f1feba62676b5e is ready but predates this snapshot and has no source commit/branch.
metrics.target_or_slo: LIVE only when canonical, mirror, identified deploy and public JSON all carry the same canonical timestamp in the same run.
metrics.interpretation: Publication is not called LIVE without a current public timestamp match.
metrics.next_action: Deploy the refreshed mirror and compare the public JSON last_updated field with the canonical timestamp.

metrics.name: Rollback Readiness Ratio
metrics.source: No live-verified production changes occurred in this run; the ratio is undefined at denominator zero. Prior stable canonical and mirror blob SHAs are retained for revert.
metrics.target_or_slo: Live changes with source commit, prior stable target and rollback instructions / live changes.
metrics.interpretation: Rollback evidence exists for repository edits, but there is no live change denominator yet.
metrics.next_action: When publication becomes live, record deployed commit, prior stable commit and tested revert instruction.

metrics.name: Task Success Rate
metrics.source: Attempted-task and outcome classification ledger is incomplete.
metrics.target_or_slo: Tasks completed to requested outcome without repeated user correction / attempted user tasks.
metrics.interpretation: This automation run alone is not a sufficient rolling denominator.
metrics.next_action: Classify each attempted task as first-pass success, recovery success, correct block or incomplete/false done.

metrics.name: Live Completion Rate
metrics.source: Tasks requiring live proof and tasks obtaining live proof are not stored as a complete pair.
metrics.target_or_slo: Tasks obtaining required live proof / tasks requiring live proof.
metrics.interpretation: Publication remains unverified and no complete task denominator exists.
metrics.next_action: Add requires_live_proof and live_verified fields to the delivery outcome ledger.

metrics.name: False Success Rate
metrics.source: This run made zero SUCCESS/DONE claims before required evidence and explicitly withheld LIVE publication status.
metrics.target_or_slo: SLO: zero critical false-success claims.
metrics.interpretation: The critical count is zero; the ratio is undefined because there were no SUCCESS/DONE claims in the run.
metrics.next_action: Keep the publication and provider gates blocking success until current live proof exists.

metrics.name: Eval Pass Rate
metrics.source: Local deterministic checks: JSON parse, schema-v5 dashboard validator, and canonical/mirror identity validator.
metrics.target_or_slo: All executed deterministic samples pass; severity critical/high failures = 0.
metrics.interpretation: The new observable-outcomes schema and publication guard passed all executed checks.
metrics.next_action: Rerun in GitHub Actions after the canonical commit and record the workflow result.

metrics.name: Correct Abstention Rate
metrics.source: Two decision-critical evidence gaps were encountered and correctly reported: current public timestamp and provider-readiness denominator.
metrics.target_or_slo: Evidence-missing cases correctly reported unknown/blocked/needs-verification / evidence-missing cases.
metrics.interpretation: No unsupported LIVE or provider-ready claim was made.
metrics.next_action: Preserve abstention until public and provider evidence is current.

metrics.name: Verification Retry Rate
metrics.source: Three verification sequences were used: canonical GitHub source, live/public fetch path, and Netlify deploy metadata. No avoidable repeated verification sequence was counted.
metrics.target_or_slo: Avoidable repeated verification attempts / verification sequences.
metrics.interpretation: Public fetch failures were cross-checked through a different evidence source rather than repeated blindly.
metrics.next_action: Instrument retry reason and evidence gained for each future verification sequence.

metrics.name: Duplicate Scan Rate
metrics.source: Four bounded scans were performed: metric contract, dashboard snapshot, scheduler registry, and publication/deploy evidence; none repeated a broad scan with no new evidence.
metrics.target_or_slo: Repeated broad scans producing no new evidence / scans.
metrics.interpretation: The run stayed scoped to required evidence sources.
metrics.next_action: Keep scan IDs and evidence deltas in future automation logs.

metrics.name: Avoidable Handoff Rate
metrics.source: One safe direct-execution opportunity existed for harness/dashboard changes and was executed directly rather than handed off.
metrics.target_or_slo: Tasks transferred after safe direct execution was available / tasks where safe direct execution was available.
metrics.interpretation: The run applied repository changes itself.
metrics.next_action: Use handoffs only for product/provider/risky work outside the automation boundary.

metrics.name: Context/Retry Cost
metrics.source: Token usage, context growth and provider/API retry cost are not exposed as a stable machine-readable source.
metrics.target_or_slo: Record model/tool retries, avoidable reruns, context growth and provider/API cost when available.
metrics.interpretation: No cost estimate was invented.
metrics.next_action: Add non-sensitive counters for tool calls, retries and context size to automation outcome records.

metrics.name: Evidence Completeness
metrics.source: 24 metric records × 17 required fields; all required fields are present. Unknown evidence remains explicitly unknown rather than omitted.
metrics.target_or_slo: Required evidence fields present / required evidence fields.
metrics.interpretation: Schema completeness is full; this does not convert unknown outcomes into measured outcomes.
metrics.next_action: Keep the validator enforcing required fields and explicit unknown values.

metrics.name: Failure-Class Coverage
metrics.source: After this run, failure-replay-cases.json contains 8 candidate failure classes and prompt-regression-tests.json contains at least one matching deterministic test for each class.
metrics.target_or_slo: Active recurring failure classes covered by a regression/replay/behavior fixture / active recurring failure classes.
metrics.interpretation: Coverage is complete for the current 8-class registry; fixture quality still depends on eval execution.
metrics.next_action: Add a class only when a new repeated failure is evidenced, then add its deterministic fixture.

metrics.name: Rule Lifecycle
metrics.source: Eight failure classes are marked candidate after adding the observable-metrics evidence regression. No canonical evidence was found that promotes them to active rules or classifies revision/supersession counts.
metrics.target_or_slo: Promote only after repeated operational evidence or one documented high-severity prevention case.
metrics.interpretation: The registry is coverage-rich but lifecycle maturity is not yet measured.
metrics.next_action: Add lifecycle state transitions with evidence references and reviewed_at timestamps.

metrics.name: Scheduler Health
metrics.source: Automations registry at 2026-07-13 shows exactly one enabled Morning System Upgrade and one enabled Evening Architecture Review; active duplicates for these titles = 0.
metrics.target_or_slo: Exactly one enabled Morning and one enabled Evening schedule; zero active duplicates.
metrics.interpretation: The critical scheduler SLO is met.
metrics.next_action: Recheck enabled counts and duplicate titles in the Evening run.

canonical_updated.evidence_reference: Schema-v5 observable_outcomes_v2 snapshot updated in this run.

mirror_synced.evidence_reference: Mirror is written with the byte-equivalent JSON snapshot in this run.

deploy_identified.evidence_reference: A ready production deploy is identified, but it predates this snapshot and has no Git source commit or branch.

live_verified.failure_reason: Current public JSON could not be retrieved; timestamp equality with canonical is unproven.
live_verified.evidence_reference: Public fetch was unavailable in this run; LIVE is withheld.

applied_upgrades.metric_effect: Replaced decision-making 0-100 estimates with 24 observed count/ratio/duration/state metrics and explicit unknown values.
Enforces metric model, field completeness, independent momentum lanes, publication gates and identical canonical/mirror snapshots.
Adds a machine-readable failure class against invented denominators, fake zeros and decision-making legacy scores.

missing_instrumentation.gap: Delivery outcome ledger lacks selected-task, accepted-at, deploy and live-verification pairs.
missing_instrumentation.exact_handoff: Add selected_for_delivery_at, first_delivery_commit_at, deploy_id, source_commit_sha, branch, requires_live_proof, live_verified_at, outcome_class and rework_events to each delivery record.

missing_instrumentation.gap: Provider-dependent production surface denominator is undefined.
missing_instrumentation.exact_handoff: Create a provider-surface registry with one row per active surface and current proof timestamps for repo/branch, deploy, route, provider, persistence/RLS, payment/webhook when applicable and rollback target.
Select one active project and record one KPI source with offer/campaign, qualified leads, orders, conversion rate, revenue or retention plus owner and update cadence.
Store non-sensitive tool-call, retry-reason, duplicate-scan, context-size and provider-cost counters per automation run.

evening_verification_questions: Did GitHub Actions validate schema v5 on the final canonical commit?
Does the mirror remain byte-equivalent to canonical after all commits?
Was a new Netlify deploy created from the refreshed mirror, and what deploy ID/source commit/branch does it report?
Does the public JSON last_updated equal 2026-07-13T10:06:11+03:00 exactly?
Did any Product Delivery or Business Growth outcome become observable without counting issues, prompts, docs or routing?

activity_log.summary: Migrated the health dashboard to observable_outcomes_v2, strengthened deterministic validation and added a regression fixture against invented metrics.
